nbcfdb58c0e.headline: Government Wants to Support Electric Cars. With Special Plates, They Will Be Allowed to Drive in Bus Lanes | Aktuálně.cz
nbcfdb58c0e.summary: The Czech government plans to support electric cars with measures such as exemption from tolls, registration fees, free city center access, accelerated depreciation, and purchase subsidies.
nbcfdb58c0e.why: Government incentives for electric vehicles can accelerate adoption, impacting the automotive and energy sectors.
